{{Quote|These visions threaten to break through all the discipline I've gained in my training|The Jedi's datapad found held in a severed arm|<ref name="KotOR II game" />}}
The Jedi was an individual who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. In [[3951 BBY]], Jedi exile [[Meetra Surik]] found the Jedi's severed arm in a pool of blood holding a datapad in the [[Tomb of Ludo Kressh|Tomb]] of [[Ludo Kressh]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Despite the datapad suffering damage, the final entry was burned onto the display screen which explained that the Jedi was ordered to wait for the return of the members of the Jedi expedition and how the visions were beginning to break the Jedi's discipline.<ref name="KotOR II game" />

==Equipment==
At the time of death, the Jedi carried a datapad and an [[Eriadu stealth unit]].<ref name="KotOR II game" />

==Behind the scenes==
The corpse of the Jedi is labeled as '''Severed Arm Holding Datapad'''. The Jedi's datapad in the player's inventory is listed as '''Blown Out Datapad.'''<ref name="KotOR II game" />
